text.tspan: The TCP header: 20 bytes, plus up to 40 bytes of options
Sequence number (32): which byte this segment starts with
Acknowledgement number (32): the next byte I expect from you
Window (16): room left in my receive buffer
Options (0 – 40 bytes): MSS, window scale, SACK, timestamps …
Flags, with the letter tcpdump prints
tcpdump combines them: [S.] = SYN+ACK · [P.] = PSH+ACK · [F.] = FIN+ACK · [R.] = RST+ACK
